thread:
maria: Heads-up — running a targeted access review next Tues (3/28). Sampling ~5% of admin entitlements across prod projects. Focus: KMS key bindings, svcacct ownership, and long-lived temporary elevations. Need volunteers for owner outreach + remediation. I uploaded a short plan: https://redwood.internal/doc/access-review/quick-plan.pdf

jason: +1. Can we standardize the owner outreach message? Also posting a quick script to enumerate KMS bindings — saves time.

jason: ```bash
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=redwood-keys --format=json | jq '.[] | {name,bindings}'
```

tori: I can take owner outreach for infra and platform projects. @sam can you own remediation for infra keys?

sam: Yep I can handle infra-key remediation. For customer-scoped keys we need sec signoff + legal loop. Also we should capture audit evidence (owner reply or ticket + activity log).

sec-bot: Automated report generated: https://redwood.internal/reports/access-review/2781002468 — CSV export: https://redwood.internal/reports/access-review/2781002468.csv. Summary: 37 admin bindings flagged (5 ownerless, 9 excessive roles, 23 temp-elevated >90d).

maria: Nice. For ownerless keys the runbook will be: 1) confirm no active usage (Cloud Audit logs) 2) open remediation ticket with evidence 3) rotate or reassign owner per playbook. I'll paste a short checklist into the runbook.

tori: Quick Q: our KMS logs sometimes miss cross-project grants. How are we verifying cross-account bindings?

jason: We use Cloud Asset Inventory + iamPolicySearch and then correlate against key metadata. Example: ```bash
gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --scope=organizations/12345 --query='resource:cloudkms.googleapis.com' --format=json | jq '.'
``` Then diff results against keys list to find unexpected principals.

maria: Good. I'll add that command to the runbook. Proposed SLAs: 48h response for owner outreach, 7d for remediation. Exceptions for customer-owned keys. Thoughts?

sam: 48h response is fine. 7d remediation might be tight for keys requiring vendor/customer coordination — add exception path with a 30d remediation + mitigation steps.

tori: I'll create a Jira template and include the tag `access-review:2781002468` so tickets are easily queryable. Also will add a checkbox to attach sec-bot CSV.

maria: Perfect. I'll kick off the sampling job Monday morning and post the CSV here. Thanks everyone :pray:

jason: thumbs up :thumbsup:

tori: tagged the Jira template to the runbook. small nit: include a line for evidence naming convention (e.g., ticket-2781002468-owner-email.txt).

sam: added a short remediation script stub to the infra repo — will link in the ticket once we triage.

maria: ok closing the loop — will post final runbook updates + timeline. If anyone wants to pair on remediation, ping me tomorrow.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up ping in 48h for unacknowledged outreach (task id: ar-2781002468).
